summary: Resume unfinished work without duplicating completed changes.
text: The previous execution was interrupted. Inspect the actual repository state, recent commits, and roadmap. Resume the next unfinished task without repeating completed work or assuming interrupted work succeeded. Implement, verify, commit, and repeat toward 100% completion. Follow established rules.

situation.trigger: A chat or execution stops unexpectedly while agreed development remains unfinished.
situation.purpose: Resume the established project after an interrupted chat or execution.

intent.outcome: Resume unfinished work without duplicating completed changes.

appropriate_when: The current project is known or recoverable
not_appropriate_when: There is no earlier authorized project
The user only wants to learn why execution failed
preconditions: Check repository and last verified work before repeating changes

execution.objective: Resume the established project after an interrupted chat or execution.

guards_against: Treating an isolated blocker as global completion
tradeoffs: The interruption may conceal partially applied changes
